definitions.explanation: A line drawn or running horizontally. Used in drawing, writing, mathematics, and everyday descriptions.

examples.japanese: {横線|よこせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{横線|よこせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I drew a horizontal line using a ruler.

examples.japanese: ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{横線|よこせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧やすい。
examples.english: Notebooks with horizontal lines are easier to write in.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横線|よこせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a horizontal line
- {横線|よこせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to have horizontal lines (e.g., lined paper)
- {横線|よこせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to cross out with a horizontal line (strikethrough)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縦線|たてせん}→縦線：25122_tatesen⟧: vertical line
- ⟦{斜線|しゃせん}→斜線：08120_shasen⟧: diagonal line

RELATED WORDS:
In kanji stroke terminology, horizontal strokes are called {横画|おうかく}. In general use, {横線|よこせん} refers to any visible horizontal line — on paper, screens, forms, or physical surfaces.
